changedBeliefs: Exp 203's per-cell `sqlite3_column_value` reuse pattern is also measurable on the rows path. `Database.select()` decode on 10k-row INTEGER, short-TEXT, and mixed-schema lanes runs roughly 1-6% faster on `select_rows_step_row_ffi.dart` with same-sign deltas across two order-flipped passes.

`resqlite_step_row`, `resqlite_step_row_hash`, and `resqlite_query_hash` share the same per-cell FFI prologue as `write_json_to_buf`, so the same `Mem*`-reuse mechanism applies to every prepared-statement decode loop in the codebase, not only the JSON encoder.
nextSignals: Use `select_rows_step_row_ffi.dart` as the durable focused gate for any future rows-path decode change.

Short-cell stream workloads (`single_stream_long_payload_hash.dart`) are still dominated by the FNV byte fold; do not retry per-cell FFI work on the unchanged-fanout hash path without a workload where the byte fold is not the floor.
Future per-cell FFI savings should target the remaining `sqlite3_column_count` / `sqlite3_column_bytes` calls per query rather than re-attacking the typed-getter pattern.
